items.summary: Update the DailyProductionReportForm component at frontend/src/components/DailyProductionReportForm.tsx to change the 'Total Completed' field from a manual input to a read-only calculated field that automatically computes the cumulative running total by fetching all previous production records for the selected operation from the database and adding today's production value to the sum

Update the backend createDailyProductionReport and updateDailyProductionReport functions in backend/main.mo to automatically calculate and store the cumulative total_completed value by querying all previous daily production reports for the given operation_id, summing their today_production values, and adding the current today_production value

Update the DailyProductionReportForm component to automatically calculate and display the 'In Hand' field as a read-only value computed as Total Completed minus Despatch (In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch), recalculating whenever either Total Completed or Despatch values change

Add an optional 'Batch Dispatch Entry' input field at the top of the DailyProductionReportForm component that, when filled with a dispatch quantity value, automatically populates the Despatch field for all 17 operations with the same value, allowing administrators to enter a single container dispatch count that applies to all operations simultaneously

Update the ContainerDailyReportPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportPage.tsx to display calculated values for each operation row using the formula: In Hand = Total Completed - Despatch, ensuring all numeric columns show accurate computed values based on database records
